name: Snake (Oracle Mystery)
body:
Class Skills: An oracle with the snake mystery adds Climb, Escape Artist, Intimidate, Stealth, and Swim to her list of class skills.

Bonus Spells: nauseating dart (2nd), extreme flexibility (4th), sundered serpent coil (6th), spit venom (8th), snake staff (10th), fire snake (12th), summon monster Vii (snakes only) (14th), animal shapes (snakes only) (16th), summon elder worm (18th).

Revelations: An oracle with the snake mystery can choose from any of the following revelations.

Constrict (Ex)

You gain a bonus equal to 1/2 your oracle level on Escape Artist checks. At 3rd level, you gain Improved Grapple as a bonus feat without having to meet the prerequisites. At 11th level, you gain Greater Grapple as a bonus feat without having to meet the prerequisites.

Fangs (Ex)

You grow a set of fangs which you can use as a primary natural bite attack. Your fangs deal 1d6 + 1&1/2 times your Str modifier piercing damage (1d4 Small, 1d8 Large). If you combine the fang attack with manufactured weapon attacks, it becomes a natural secondary attack which is made at -5 to hit and deals 1d6 + 1/2 your Str modifier damage. At 3rd level, in addition to piercing damage, your fangs deal 1d6 poison damage. At 7th level, when you make a successful fang attack, your target must make a successful Fortitude saving throw (DC = 10 + 1/2 your oracle level + your Charisma modifier) or gained the sickened condition for 1 round.

Poison Immunity (Ex)

You gain a +4 circumstance bonus on Fortitude saves against poison. At 11th level, you gain immunity to poison.

Scales (Ex)

As a swift action, you can transform your skin into scales that grant you a +4 armor bonus. At 7th level, and every four levels thereafter, this bonus increases by +2. You can use your scales for 1 hour per day per oracle level. This duration does not need to be consecutive, but it must be spent in 1-hour increments.

Scent (Ex)

You gain scent.

Slither (Ex)

You gain a 20 foot climb speed. At 7th level, you gain a 30 foot swim speed. You must be at least 3rd level to select this revelation.

Snake Oil (Ex)

You can convince anyone of anything. You gain Skill Focus (bluff) as a bonus feat and can use the Bluff skill in place of Diplomacy and Intimidate skill checks.

Spitting Mad (Ex)

You can spit venom from your mouth in a 10 foot line. Creatures in the line must make a Reflex saving throw (DC = 10 + 1/2 your oracle level + your Charisma modifier). On a failed save, a creature takes 2d6 + 1 point per oracle level poison damage and is temporarily blinded for 1 round. On a successful save, a creature takes half damage and isn’t blinded. You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Charisma modifier. You must be at least 7th level to select this revelation.

Sun Healing (Su)

As a full-round action, when you are in an area of sunlight, you can activate this ability to heal yourself. You heal a number of hit points equal to your Charisma modifier + twice your oracle level.

At 7th level, in addition to healing hit points, this ability also acts as a lesser restoration spell. At 14th level, in addition to healing hit points, this ability also acts as a restoration spell. You can use this ability once per day, plus one additional time per day at 7th level and 14th level.

Sway (Ex)

After you make a successful melee attack against a creature, you can use a swift action to lock gazes with it and begin to sway. The creature must make a successful Will saving throw (DC = 10 + 1/2 your oracle level + your Charisma modifier) or divide its attention between your swaying and all other activities, gaining a -2 circumstance penalty on all attack rolls and Concentration checks until the start of your next turn. At 19th level, the circumstance penalty doubles.

Final Revelation

Upon reaching 20th level, each day as a spell-like ability, you can summon a giant anaconda to your side with a swift action. It is friendly towards you, can understand your directions as though you are under the effects of speak with animals, and will protect you to the best of its ability. It disappears if it is reduced to fewer than 0 hit points or when 1 hour has elapsed, whichever comes first.
